chunks: This is a Day they will not be able to speak.
ai.seo_question: Who will be unable to speak on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (often linked to Surah Al-Mutaffifin or Al-Anbiya depending on the specific recitation context) underscores the absolute silence of the guilty on the Day of Judgment, contrasting with the eloquent defense of the righteous. It reflects the concept of *Hajr* (divine barrier) where their own tongues and limbs bear witness against them, fulfilling the promise that no excuse will be accepted. This moment signifies the finality of divine justice, where the internal state of the heart is fully externalized.
